_source: Built 2026-11-21: PayPal lists VAULT.PAYMENT-TOKEN.DELETED (https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/webhooks/event-names/) but publishes no sample; shaped like its other webhook events (CUSTOMER.DISPUTE.CREATED.json), the resource a payment token as Payment Method Tokens v3 returns it (vault-payment-token-card.json). The library reads only resource.id.
